notes.title: Trident's Tale - Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Dear Pirates

Version 1.0.1 is out now on Steam.,
Restart your Steam client in order to fetch the update.

------ Changelog ------
[list]
[*] Fixed and polishing for some cutscenes
[*] Fixed some incorrect Audio Behaviors 
[*] Small fixes for naval exploration
[*] Motion Blur post process fixes
[*] Improvement some fps during turntable camera
[/list]
